question: Can an action-conditioned complete second public record distinguish equal-prior three-edge physical errors that share the same full first flux, after conditioning on the same complete all-zero-charge first record?
fork_classification: The 120 exact three-edge first-flux collisions contain 12/72/36 sectors in the canonical-base first-likelihood strata 1, 1/2 and 1/4. A matched direct matrix across all three independent strata and both fixed public actions is the smallest in-budget prerequisite before any proposed operator-law reduction or full-channel extrapolation; no human ranking of the strata is required. An action-covariant automorphism proof is a separate reduction hypothesis, not assumed or needed for these direct cells.

hypotheses.incremental_witness: At least one positive-first-mass equal-prior pair has different complete conditional second-public laws under a fixed public action.
hypotheses.finite_null: Every positive-first-mass selected pair has identical complete conditional second-public laws under both actions; this remains a three-sector null only.
hypotheses.first_exclusion: A selected alternative has zero mass for the specified first record; its second conditional law is undefined and that stratum is recorded as first-record exclusion, without replacement selection.
hypotheses.censored: Any provenance, cost, commutation, normalization or independent-moment gate fails; no partial matrix is promoted.

frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 operator orbit, 36 IID red-X edges at p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0. Signal-only pre-action full 24-site binary flux/charge/vacuum first record has the selected sector's common flux, all charge bits zero and vacuum=1-charge. Two relation-free fixed public charge actions are [0] and [1,30,32,34,35], binding the full action-conditioned second public flux/charge/vacuum record. Private error support is used only for generation/scoring and never to choose the action.

matrix.sector_selection: Enumerate all 7,140 three-edge supports and retain the 120 first-flux sectors with exactly two such supports. In each canonical-base first-likelihood stratum, select the sector with largest exact J8T sector prior; lexicographic pair of supports breaks ties. Freeze both equal-prior supports and do not replace a selected sector after inspecting its law.
matrix.cells: Three prospectively selected collision sectors × two equal-prior same-first-flux private errors × two fixed public actions. Evaluate each complete first law, then every positive-first-mass action-conditioned complete second public law. Compare exact conditional total variation per pair/action; null when a first mass is zero.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact private-error/action cell within a selected flux sector; matched first public record and fixed public action. Exact rationals, no stochastic uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin all source/result inputs and runner. Replay 120 collision sectors and 12/72/36 strata, unique deterministic selection and equal three-edge IID priors. Verify first/second flux and residual action binding, eligible first/second sites, pairwise commutation, signed-affine first mass against independent direct ordered-projector probability, one independent direct second moment per positive cell, nonnegative normalized full-binary second rows, exact TV in [0,1], source/hash stability and zero histories/arms/bootstraps.

acceptance: All three deterministic equal-prior collision strata selected and all six complete first laws verified; all positive-first-mass second-law cells normalized and independently spot-checked
Both fixed-action paired exact second-law total variations reported per stratum, or explicitly undefined on first-record exclusion
No geometry/operator-law symmetry, full-IID information/risk, noisy JIT, size scaling or threshold claim
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen three-stratum/two-error/two-action matrix or first integrity/65,536-term/60-CPU-second cap. Do not add sectors, change actions/first records, sample histories or enlarge budget. A zero selected alternative first mass is retained as first-record exclusion, not replaced.
